curves.blurb: Risky brawler: every missing heart hits harder, and one knockout is never the end.
Speed demon: chain Sets inside 5 seconds, then cash a max Combo in for double damage.
Gambler: guess boldly. Every mistake is ammo, and the first one each wave is free.
Sniper: wait for the perfect Set, then freeze the world with a Rainbow Strike.
Board shaper: fetches power and gold cards, then zooms the whole board clean.
Laid-back: free Sets, free glows. The board does half the work for you.

solo.name: Monochrome Pact
solo.upside: Sets with only 1 different trait deal +6 bonus damage, and every Set deals +12%.
solo.tradeoff: All-different Sets deal 0.5× damage instead of 1×.

solo.name: Prismatic Fever
solo.upside: All-different Sets deal 3× damage and restore +1s on timed fights.
solo.tradeoff: Non-Rainbow Sets deal −2 base damage (min 1) and foes enter with +30% HP.

solo.name: Controlled Burn
solo.upside: Every 4s, a wrong Set ignites 4 board cards instead of costing a heart; Sets deal +45% damage.
solo.tradeoff: You start each fight with 0 Graces.

solo.name: Glass Prism
solo.upside: Power (+2 dmg) and Gold (+3¢) cards appear 4× as often, and Sets deal +45% damage.
solo.tradeoff: Your maximum Hearts are locked to 3.

solo.name: Overkill Harvest
solo.upside: Every point of overkill damage past 0 HP pays +2 coins; Sets deal +28% and wave clears heal +1 Heart.
solo.tradeoff: Foes enter the arena with +8% HP.

solo.name: Scholar's Gambit
solo.upside: 1.5× XP gained, 4 weapon choices per level-up, and +10% Set damage.
solo.tradeoff: Foes enter the arena with +15% HP.

solo.name: Catalyst Resonance
solo.upside: Catalysts appear twice as often (+1 evos/fight), Sets deal +18%, and every Evolution bursts for 18 damage + 8s.
solo.tradeoff: Foes enter the arena with +8% HP.

solo.name: Tempo Surge
solo.upside: Every valid Set deals +28% damage and refunds +1s on timed fights.
solo.tradeoff: Timed clocks tick 35% faster (or −1 move on move-limited fights, min 4).
